channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Pakistan throws open emergency land routes to Iran as Hormuz blockade continues
item.description: Pakistan opened emergency land routes to Iran due to the Hormuz blockade. Pakistan throws open emergency land routes to Iran as Hormuz blockade continues.

item.title: Attacks on Jewish Targets in Europe Suggest Hybrid Warfare
item.description: A shadowy Islamist group claimed attacks on Jewish targets in Europe. Officials are investigating similar attacks across Europe, all claimed by a shadowy Islamist group that may be using low-cost, unsophisticated methods to sow fear in Jewish communities.

item.title: U.N. Secretary-General Warns of Global Recession If Strait of Hormuz Disruption Continues - C-SPAN
item.description: The U. N. Secretary-General warned of a global recession if the Hormuz disruption continues. U. N. Secretary-General Warns of Global Recession If Strait of Hormuz Disruption Continues C-SPAN. Secretary-General Warns of Global Recession If Strait of Hormuz Disruption Continues - C-SPAN.

item.title: Zelensky demands Trump explain new ceasefire proposal after Putin’s call with US president
item.description: US President Trump had a "very good" phone call with Russian President Putin, who offered a ceasefire in Ukraine on Victory Day. The offer was welcomed by Trump. Ukraine-Russia war latest: Trump welcomes Putin’s offer of Victory Day ceasefire in ‘very good’ phone call The Independent.

item.title: Israel intercepts Gaza flotilla near Crete and detains 175 activists
item.description: Israel intercepted a Gaza flotilla near Crete and detained 175 activists. Pro-Palestinian activists say 22 boats carrying aid for Gaza were illegally intercepted in international waters near the Greek island.

item.title: Trump says US studying troop cuts in Germany, as spat with Merz intensifies
item.description: The US is studying troop cuts in Germany after a spat with the German chancellor. His remarks come after the German chancellor criticised the US approach to the war in Iran.

item.title: U.K. calls antisemitism an emergency after arson and stabbing attacks on Jewish people
item.description: The UK government pledged to increase security for Jewish communities after a string of arson attacks and a double stabbing. Members of the community criticized the government's response to rising antisemitism, now deemed an emergency.

item.title: Oil price hits highest since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options
item.description: Oil prices jumped after a report that US Central Command prepared a plan for strikes on Iran. Axios reported that US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran.

item.title: UAE oil exit from OPEC signals focus on domestic priorities
item.description: The United Arab Emirates exited OPEC, shifting focus to domestic priorities. This move signals a geopolitical change, potentially impacting ties with Saudi Arabia, the US, and Israel. Abu Dhabi's exit from OPEC signals a geopolitical shift and a pointed message to Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Guterres warns of worsening economic impact of Hormuz closure
item.description: UN Secretary-General Guterres warned of worsening economic impacts if the Strait of Hormuz closes. The closure would have significant effects on global trade and economies. Guterres warns of worsening economic impact of Hormuz closure The Times of Israel.

item.title: Why is China warning the UN of a Japanese ‘nuclear breakout’?
item.description: China warned the UN of a potential Japanese "nuclear breakout". This warning highlights rising tensions between China and Japan over nuclear issues. Why is China warning the UN of a Japanese ‘nuclear breakout’?

item.title: US military equipment worth billions of dollars destroyed in Iran war
item.description: The US military lost aerial equipment worth up to $2.8 billion during the Iran war, according to a US-based think tank. The loss is a significant blow to US military capabilities.

item.title: Indonesian soldiers accused of acid attack. What happened and why?
item.description: Indonesian soldiers allegedly carried out an acid attack, sparking concerns over a wider pattern of repression amid the military's growing role. Analysts say this is part of a broader issue.

item.title: Has the US Supreme Court weakened the Voting Rights Act – and how?
item.description: The US Supreme Court's ruling on the Voting Rights Act will have far-reaching effects, including redistricting in Louisiana. The decision was hailed as a 'big win' by Trump. Ruling, called 'big win' by Trump, will result in redistricting in Louisiana, but it will have farther-reaching effects.

item.title: Hormuz effect? How US, China are ramping up tensions over the Panama Canal
item.description: Rising tensions over the Panama Canal have prompted a showdown between the US and China in the global shipping power struggle. The dispute is escalating between the two nations. Rising tensions over Panama Canal prompt US-China showdown in global shipping power struggle.

item.title: Was Israeli PM’s Lebanon destruction video a snub to Trump?
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu posted a video of destruction in Lebanon hours after Trump asked him to stop. The move was seen as a snub to the US leader. Hours after Trump asked Netanyahu to stop destroying buildings in Lebanon, Israel's leader posted a destruction montage.

item.title: Florida Taco Bell Employee Shoots Customer Who Tried To Fill Water Cup With Soda
item.description: A Florida Taco Bell employee discharged a firearm at customers after a dispute over a water cup, causing injuries. The incident occurred at a Taco Bell location in Florida. A Florida Taco Bell worker discharged a firearm at customers after a dispute, causing injuries.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz will be 'free from American presence', Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf says
item.description: Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf said the Strait of Hormuz will be free from American presence. Pakistan is engaged with the US and Iran to end the war in West Asia.

item.title: Trump May Pull Troops From Germany. That Isn’t as Scary as It Once Was.
item.description: Germany increased its military spending to be less dependent on Washington. This may give Germany leverage in its support for US attacks on Iran. Germany has hugely increased its military spending, aiming to be less dependent on Washington.

item.title: Israel Intercepts Aid Flotilla Heading to Breach Naval Blockade of Gaza
item.description: Israel intercepted a flotilla heading to Gaza in international waters near Greece. The military boarded and disabled boats carrying humanitarian assistance. Activists said the Israeli military boarded and disabled boats carrying humanitarian assistance to the territory in international waters near Greece.
